note: Shale Bluff campground sits on a bluff above the lake, with filtered lake views and trails down to the water, not at the water's edge. The on-water sites are in the separate Wooster primitive campground. --Claude
summary: Fees confirmed: $14 is the Wooster primitive rate, not stale, and it is a site EKKO fits (6 of 8 Wooster sites allow 25-45 ft, RV category); electric $33. 50A, year-round confirmed. Count 149 -> 157 (adds Wooster's 8), max rig 60, dump and RA link added; note cleaned. Waterfront re-audit lead at Wooster.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (re-audit, stored not waterfront): Wooster is 8 RA primitive sites typed RV/Tent/Trailer, Drive-In, with 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' on every site I opened in full (six of them) and 'Near Water' on all 8 in the list. Max vehicle lengths: 152 and 153 = 20 ft; 009H = 25; 158 = 30; 159 = 35; 155 = 40; 156, 157 = 45. Imagery at 38.7731,-85.6905 shows the loop on a small peninsula in Wooster Bay with water close on the north and east sides, and DNR's map draws 155 at the shoreline. Shale Bluff (the 149 electric sites) stays above the water; RA marks those not near water. So a 23-ft rig can use on-water sites here, at $14, no hookups. DNR calls Wooster 'primarily to serve fishermen and primitive campers' and allows mooring a boat overnight.

LOW WATER: DNR, dated 8-13-26: 'Due to the continued draw down of Hardy Lake by the Water Utility, both Carmel and Sunnyside boat ramps are now closed.' Hardy is a water-supply reservoir, so shoreline conditions vary. Wooster's own ramp isn't named; the alert says to call. Campgrounds not closed, so no status.
PIN: fine for Shale Bluff. RA per-site GIS (24 sites) centres on 38.7767,-85.69233, about 210 m from the stored 38.775817,-85.694543. Under the 250 m line; given in case you want it tighter.

SPLIT: not recommended. Wooster's sites are about 410 m from Shale Bluff's centre (38.7730,-85.6915 against 38.7767,-85.6923, RA GIS) and both come off the same park road from the office; Wooster's spur is the Wooster Ramp road.
PHONE: stored empty; park office 812-794-3800 (DNR park page and maps). Overpass was down, so positions are from RA GIS and imagery.
ONE VEHICLE and one camping unit per Wooster site (DNR map). RA lists 143 electric where DNR says 149.
